comments.text: Dragons are real — and they live in Indonesia! 🐉 The Komodo dragon is the world's largest lizard, growing up to 3 meters long and 135kg heavy, with a venomous bite. When will Americans ever learn to pronounce foreign names the way they should be pronounced? Answer: NEVER. Reason: they know it better. Well, they think they know it better. It sounds so ridiculous. Better set the volume to zero if you want to enjoy the video.

Some parts, which are less important are shown extremely long, other parts are not shown at all, then it is back to a part which has been shown before, in other words it is a disaster. I love Indonesia, I come there for over 40 years now, not every year although if I add up the amount of times I have been there it will be close to 40 thanks to visiting 2 times per year. This video does not show Indonesia as it could be shown. If the trips you sell are just as bad then I wonder if you have any clients at all.
